feeds.title: Amanda Robins Psychotherapy Blog
feeds.description: Amanda Robins' blog shares gentle, therapeutic guidance on healing from trauma, especially for daughters of narcissistic mothers. She writes about self-acceptance, emotional wounds, and creative or somatic approaches to recovery.

feeds.title: Meg Haworth Blog
feeds.description: Dr Meg Haworth's blog focuses on holistic healing for survivors of narcissistic and childhood trauma. She blends mind body medicine, nutrition, and emotional healing to help people release stored trauma, rebuild self-worth, and create healthier patterns.

feeds.title: Dr. Mary Ann Little Blog
feeds.description: Dr Mary Ann Little's blog explores parenting, childhood narcissism, family dynamics, and emotional development. She draws from her decades of experience as a clinical psychologist, offering insights on how certain parenting styles can influence children's self-esteem, empathy, and future relationships. Her writing is research-informed and practical, helping parents understand how to guide healthy emotional growth.

feeds.title: Dr. Karyl McBride Blog
feeds.description: Dr Karyl McBride's Psychology Today blog focuses on healing from maternal narcissism and its lifelong emotional effects. She writes about rebuilding self-worth, calming the inner critic, setting boundaries, and understanding patterns formed in childhood.

feeds.title: Grace Wroldson Blog
feeds.description: Grace Wroldson's blog focuses on healing from toxic relationships, especially narcissistic abuse. She writes about co-parenting with a narcissist, using non-attachment and non-resistance to protect well-being, overcoming self-sabotage in codependent relationships, and strategic ways to document manipulation in high-conflict custody battles

feeds.title: COURAGE COACHING
feeds.description: Courage Coaching is run by Athina, who helps adult children of narcissistic parents heal from emotional trauma. Her work focuses on building self-worth, reducing anxiety, and understanding patterns created by dysfunctional families. She offers one-to-one coaching and a private support group for daughters of narcissistic mothers, creating a safe and compassionate space for recovery.

feeds.title: Glynis Sherwood Blog
feeds.description: Glynis Sherwood's blog offers clear, therapeutic guidance on recovering from family scapegoating, narcissistic abuse, and long-term trauma. She writes about emotional healing, healthy boundaries, self-worth, grief, and coping patterns formed in dysfunctional families. Her articles blend professional insight with practical advice, making the blog a supportive space for people dealing with toxic family dynamics and seeking long-term recovery.

feeds.title: lynncatalano Blog
feeds.description: My name is Lynn Catalano, and I'm a Narcissistic Abuse Coach. My blog talks about all topics of Narcissistic Abuse, including gaslighting, hyper-vigilance, triangulation, the silent treatment, financial abuse, coercive control, and belittling. I help people begin their healing journey.

feeds.title: Tereza's Health Blog
feeds.description: My journey to better health and what I have learned along the way. Tereza's Health Blog explains that narcissistic parents manipulate and scapegoat their children, causing deep emotional harm. Healing involves recognizing the abuse, setting boundaries, and reclaiming self-worth.

feeds.title: Laura K. Connell Blog
feeds.description: Helping you heal the physical, emotional & financial impact of maternal narcissistic abuse so you can create the peace, success & happiness you deserve.

feeds.title: Mom Behind The Smile Blog
feeds.description: Explore healing insights, journal prompts, and supportive advice for women recovering from narcissistic abuse. The Mom Behind The Smile blog is a safe space to grow, reflect, and reclaim your voice.

feeds.title: Children of Narcissists
feeds.description: Children of Narcissists is a UK-based counselling and blog site that focuses on the impact of narcissistic parenting. It explains how narcissistic behaviour affects children, covering issues like trauma, attachment problems, guilt, and self-worth. The blog also shares guidance on healing and offers counselling support for adults recovering from narcissistic family dynamics.

feeds.title: The Narcissist Family Files
feeds.description: The Narcissist Family Files is an award-winning international resource for survivors of narcissistic abuse and trauma, founded by journalist and author of The Narcissist in Your Life Julie L. Hall.

feeds.title: The Good Daughter Syndrome Blog
feeds.description: Daughters Rising supports women healing from family trauma, including the effects of narcissistic or emotionally abusive parents. The site shares guidance, personal growth tools, and educational resources to help daughters rebuild confidence, set boundaries, and break unhealthy generational patterns.

feeds.title: The Nurturing Coach Blog
feeds.description: I'm Sarah, The Nurturing Coach, and founder of NAPARRC. I am a narcissistic abuse and parental alienation specialist. As part of NAPARRC we offer free group support both in person and online. My work is one:one for those of you who need that little bit more support.

feeds.title: Jay Reid
feeds.description: J. Reid Therapy is run by psychotherapist Jay Reid and focuses on helping adult survivors of narcissistic abuse, especially those who grew up as the family scapegoat. The site offers detailed blogs, guides, and recovery resources that explain narcissistic family dynamics and provide tools for rebuilding self-worth.

feeds.title: Jim McGee Coaching Blog
feeds.description: Jim McGee Coaching's blog is focused on healing from narcissistic abuse and complex trauma (C-PTSD). Jim McGee, a trauma-informed coach, writes about relational trauma, family scapegoating, and narcissistic parenting, offering guidance and insights for survivors.
